terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms and Conditions explain the rules for accessing and using the DatumSaas website, demos, and related communication channels.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: By accessing this website, you agree to these Terms and Conditions and to all applicable laws and regulations.
If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you should discontinue use of the website and related forms.

sections.heading: 2. Scope of Website Use
paragraphs: This website is provided for informational and commercial communication purposes, including booking demos and requesting product information.
You may use the website only for lawful business purposes and may not attempt to interfere with normal operation, performance, or security.

sections.heading: 3. No Account Required for Public Pages
paragraphs: Browsing public pages does not require an account, but some linked services may redirect to external or client-specific platforms.
Where external platforms are involved, their own terms and privacy conditions will apply in addition to these website terms.

sections.heading: 4. Contact Forms and Submitted Information
paragraphs: When you submit forms, you agree to provide accurate, current, and complete business information.
You are responsible for ensuring that submitted data does not infringe third-party rights or include unlawful content.

sections.heading: 5. Marketing and Communication Consent

Where legally required, additional consent options may be presented before promotional messaging is sent.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual Property

You may not reproduce, distribute, modify, or create derivative works from website materials without prior written authorization.

This license does not grant any ownership rights and can be revoked at any time in cases of misuse.

sections.heading: 8. Prohibited Conduct

You also agree not to use the website in a way that degrades service for other visitors or violates applicable data protection law.

sections.heading: 9. Third-Party Tools and Links

DatumSaas is not responsible for independent third-party terms, uptime, or security practices outside our direct control.

sections.heading: 10. Service and Content Availability

We do not guarantee uninterrupted access and may perform maintenance or emergency updates as needed.

sections.heading: 11. Informational Nature of Content
paragraphs: All website materials are provided for general information and commercial orientation and do not constitute legal, financial, tax, or compliance advice.
You should seek professional advice before making decisions based solely on content displayed on this website.

sections.heading: 12. Disclaimer of Warranties

To the maximum extent allowed by law, DatumSaas disclaims warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement.

In all cases, any liability related to website access will be limited to the minimum amount required by applicable law.

sections.heading: 14. Indemnification

This includes claims related to unlawful data submissions, intellectual property violations, or abusive automated access.

sections.heading: 15. Privacy and Data Protection

If there is a conflict between these terms and mandatory privacy law, mandatory legal requirements will prevail.

sections.heading: 16. Jurisdiction and Governing Law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction where DatumSaas is established, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
Any dispute arising from website use shall be resolved in the competent courts of that jurisdiction unless otherwise required by law.

sections.heading: 17. Changes to These Terms

sections.heading: 18. Contact

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how DatumSaas collects, uses, stores, and protects personal and business information submitted through this website.

sections.heading: 1. Policy Scope
paragraphs: This policy applies to personal and business information collected through DatumSaas public website pages, forms, and contact interactions.
It does not automatically apply to third-party platforms linked from this website, which maintain their own privacy practices.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect identifiers and business context such as full name, email, phone number, company, team size, industry, and requested capabilities.
We may also collect message content and optional details that help us understand your operational needs.

sections.heading: 3. Technical and Usage Data
paragraphs: We may automatically collect technical information including device type, browser, language, referring URL, pages viewed, and interaction timestamps.
This data helps us maintain site performance, improve usability, and detect suspicious activity.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies and Similar Technologies
paragraphs: DatumSaas may use cookies and similar storage technologies to remember preferences, measure engagement, and optimize site behavior.
Where required by law, you can choose to accept or reject non-essential cookies through website controls.

sections.heading: 5. How We Use Information
paragraphs: Submitted information is used to respond to inquiries, schedule demos, evaluate fit, and coordinate commercial follow-up.
We may also use aggregated and non-identifiable data for analytics, planning, and service quality improvement.

sections.heading: 6. Legal Bases for Processing
paragraphs: Depending on your jurisdiction, processing may be based on consent, legitimate interest, pre-contractual necessity, or legal obligation.
When consent is required, you may withdraw it at any time without affecting prior lawful processing.

sections.heading: 7. Data Sharing and Service Providers
paragraphs: We may share limited data with vetted providers that support hosting, automation, CRM workflows, analytics, scheduling, and communications.
These providers are contractually required to process data only under documented instructions and applicable confidentiality obligations.

sections.heading: 8. International Transfers
paragraphs: If data is transferred across borders, DatumSaas applies reasonable safeguards appropriate to the destination and applicable law.
Transfer safeguards may include contractual controls and provider-level security commitments.

sections.heading: 9. Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, comply with legal obligations, and resolve disputes.
Retention periods may vary by record type, jurisdiction, and operational necessity.

sections.heading: 10. Security Measures
paragraphs: DatumSaas uses administrative, technical, and organizational controls designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access or disclosure.
No internet transmission or storage system is fully risk-free, but we continuously improve our safeguards.

sections.heading: 11. Your Privacy Rights
paragraphs: Subject to local law, you may request access, correction, deletion, processing restriction, portability, or objection regarding your data.
We may require identity verification before processing requests to protect account and contact security.

sections.heading: 12. Marketing Preferences
paragraphs: You can opt out of promotional communications using unsubscribe options or by contacting us directly.
Transactional or service-related messages may still be sent when required to support active requests or legal obligations.

sections.heading: 13. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: This website is intended for business audiences and is not directed to children under the age required by applicable law.
If we learn that child data has been submitted without valid authorization, we will take appropriate removal steps.

sections.heading: 14. External Links
paragraphs: Website pages may include links to third-party resources. DatumSaas is not responsible for privacy practices on external domains.
We recommend reviewing the privacy notices of any third-party site you visit.

sections.heading: 15. Policy Updates
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect legal requirements, platform changes, or operational updates.
The date at the top of this page indicates the latest version, and significant updates may be highlighted where appropriate.

sections.heading: 16. Contact for Privacy Requests
paragraphs: For privacy questions or rights requests, contact info@datumsaas.com.
Please include enough detail for us to identify your request and provide a timely response.
